text:
lena: Quick sync: proposing an "Override Queue" for flagged feature overrides. Instead of immediate force-enable, team members submit override requests that are queued, audited, and subject to TTL + staggered release. Helps avoid accidental mass flips.

josh: Nice. So flow: user requests override -> goes to queue -> owner approves -> release window opens with short TTL?
lena: Exactly. Queue entry includes justification, requested window, and risk tags. Approver can grant a short window (e.g., 2m) or staged windows (2m x 3). Each release is recorded in audit and tied to telemetry snapshots.
ravi: Important: runtime must understand these limited windows. We need a token with expiry that runtimes check locally (fast path). No central hop per request.
maya: Console UX: 'Request override' button opens a small form, shows estimated impact, and a required checkbox to confirm 2FA. Show queue position and ETA. Approvers see diff and a one-click authorize with TTL pickers.
devon: Alerting: emit metrics override.requested, override.approved, override.released, override.revoked. Alert if too many concurrent overrides in prod > 3 per hour.
cara: SRE: default policy: allow at most one active override per high-risk flag unless explicit multi-override approval by infra. Add emergency single-use safemode token for oncall with auto-expiry and email audit.
zoe: Edge-case: what if an override is approved but some nodes don't receive the token due to partition? Runtimes should fallback to flag's default behavior and emit override.mismatch metric.
josh: Implementation: preflight creates an override queue item. Control plane generates a signed short-lived JWT per release. Runtimes validate signature + expiry locally. Keep verification cheap (ecdsa curve).
lena: Preflight rule: any flag enabling manual overrides must bind telemetry for override.* metrics or preflight fails. configbot: please enforce.
configbot: preflight: schema OK. WARNING: telemetry bindings missing for override.released. Auto-provision dashboard stub /dashboards/flags/4312009876-override-queue recommended.
maya: Copy note: request language should explain why an override helps and link to the dry-run timeline. For PMs, show "what will change" in plain terms.
devon: I'll draft alert thresholds and SLO impact checks. Suggested default: block approval if recent errors > threshold for that cohort.
cara: Runbook: how to revoke an override mid-window, audit steps, and escalation flow. Also weekly report of overrides to security.
lena: Action items: lena -> RFC + small PoC; josh -> JWT token sketch + perf; devon -> alerts + SLO checks; cara -> runbook; maya -> console mock + copy; zoe -> mismatch metric handling. Reconvene after RFC posted.
configbot: reminder: create RFC under /eng/flags/rfcs and attach preflight id 4312009876.
lena: thanks all :rocket:
